note: Canonical checklist definition. The Netlify function validates every submission against this file, and docs/index.html mirrors it (see the CHECKLIST array there). If you edit one, edit both -- a mismatch makes the server reject submissions with 'unrecognised checklist item' rather than silently recording bad data. Items marked pendingLegalReview are placeholders awaiting counsel and are NOT presented as confirmable.

items.text: Fall protection equipment is in place and inspected
Hard hats, gloves, and eye protection worn by all crew
Ladders are properly placed and secured
All crew members are fit for duty — rested, hydrated, and unimpaired by drugs or alcohol
First aid kit is on site and accessible
Weather checked — no lightning, high wind, or storm risk
High-visibility gear worn where required (near roadway/traffic)
Job site is clearly marked for homeowners and passersby
Vehicles and equipment are parked safely and visibly
Work area is clear of debris and trip hazards before starting
Materials are staged neatly and the site will be kept clean throughout the job
Crew has water on site and scheduled breaks planned
Crew has been briefed on today's hazards and job scope
[LEGAL PLACEHOLDER — independent contractor acknowledgment / liability language, to be drafted by counsel]
[LEGAL PLACEHOLDER — OSHA reference / regulatory citation, to be confirmed by counsel]
